name: What is the typical communication process during a design-build project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical communication process during a design-build project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our communication process emphasizes clear and consistent updates throughout your design-build project. As your single point of coordination, AKN Design Group provides a dedicated project manager who serves as your primary contact. You can expect regular progress reports, scheduled meetings, and prompt responses to your inquiries. This high-touch homeowner experience ensures you are informed at every step, from design approvals and permit coordination to construction milestones and final walkthroughs, fostering trust and transparency.
acceptedAnswer.description: A dedicated project manager provides regular updates and serves as your single point of contact, ensuring clear communication from design approval through project completion.
